import json, numpy as np, mujoco
from g1_source import activate_source
activate_source()
from stack_scene import build_model, reset_to_reference_pose
from safety_governor import manipulator_contact_violations
m=build_model(); d=mujoco.MjData(m); reset_to_reference_pose(m,d)
site=mujoco.mj_name2id(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,"right_eef")
pelvis=mujoco.mj_name2id(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,"pelvis")
initial=d.site_xpos[site].copy(); control=d.ctrl.copy(); base=d.xpos[pelvis].copy()
indices=[int(m.jnt_qposadr[mujoco.mj_name2id(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,n)]) for n in ("right_shoulder_pitch_joint","right_elbow_joint")]
poses=[]
for shoulder,elbow in ((-0.15,0.4),(-0.3,0.6),(-0.25,0.0)):
 s=mujoco.MjData(m); s.qpos[:]=d.qpos; s.qpos[indices]+=[shoulder,elbow]; mujoco.mj_forward(m,s)
 poses.append({"shoulder_delta_rad":shoulder,"elbow_delta_rad":elbow,"eef_delta_m":(s.site_xpos[site]-initial).tolist(),"collision_reasons":manipulator_contact_violations(m,s,"free_space")})
minimum=float(d.xpos[pelvis,2]); reasons=set(); maximum_tilt=0.; maximum_drift=0.
for step in range(5000):
 d.ctrl[:]=control; mujoco.mj_step(m,d)
 minimum=min(minimum,float(d.xpos[pelvis,2])); maximum_drift=max(maximum_drift,float(np.linalg.norm(d.xpos[pelvis,:2]-base[:2])))
 maximum_tilt=max(maximum_tilt,float(np.arccos(np.clip(d.xmat[pelvis].reshape(3,3)[2,2],-1,1))))
 reasons.update(manipulator_contact_violations(m,d,"free_space"))
 if not np.isfinite(d.qpos).all() or minimum<0.70: break
print(json.dumps({"kinematic_candidates":poses,"reference_hold":{"sim_time_s":d.time,"minimum_pelvis_z_m":minimum,"maximum_pelvis_xy_drift_m":maximum_drift,"maximum_pelvis_tilt_rad":maximum_tilt,"collision_reasons":sorted(reasons),"final_right_eef_delta_m":(d.site_xpos[site]-initial).tolist()}},indent=2))
